candidates.title: 用 AI 比較三份 PDF 報價：做出同規格、可追查的比價表
candidates.audience: Occasional purchasers, office administrators, event organizers, and small-business operators who receive differently formatted quotes.
candidates.one_problem: Three supplier PDFs use different quantity, tax, shipping, and product-specification conventions. Produce an apples-to-apples comparison without silently filling missing terms.
candidates.trend_evidence_strength: adjacent broad file-workflow demand; exact quotation subtopic not trend-validated
candidates.novelty: ai-citation-check checks whether a link supports a claim. This episode performs extraction, normalization, calculation, and a procurement comparison from local PDFs. Existing event-folder examples clean participant names, not quotations with incompatible units and terms.
candidates.feasibility: High. Self-authored text PDFs, local pypdf extraction, current AI assistant reasoning, Python calculations, and openpyxl workbook creation. No additional provider account, connectors, or messages to suppliers.

original_demo.job: 200 copies of a 12-page A4 double-sided color handout with binding; all suppliers and prices are fictional teaching fixtures.
original_demo.supplier_a: Matching specification. Per-copy price42; goods8400, explicit tax420, explicit shipping200, explicit total9020.
original_demo.supplier_b: Visibly lower quoted total but a nonmatching specification, such as black-and-white or only100copies. Keep the price but mark not comparable; do not infer an unquoted color upgrade or extrapolate a quantity discount.
original_demo.supplier_c: Matching specification. Per-copy price45 including tax, shipping included, total9000.
original_demo.intrinsic_teaching_result: The lower headline unit price is not necessarily the lower comparable delivered total. The apparently cheapest quote may be ineligible because it does not meet the requested specification. This is a designed arithmetic case, not a claimed model failure.
original_demo.variation: A revised supplier PDF adds a shipping fee or clarifies quantity. Rebuild the table from the revision, preserve source-page references, and show the comparable ranking update.

required_outputs: comparison.xlsx with original extracted fields, normalized terms, comparable-status and delivered-total columns
comparison.csv and a human-readable one-page comparison using the same calculated values
questions.txt containing only genuinely missing specifications or terms, with supplier/page references
updated workbook after one revised quote, plus a short change log
verification: Every extracted material value maps to an original filename and page; unsupported fields stay empty or unresolved.
Recompute totals independently from explicit fixture values. Use Decimal or integer cents, not model mental arithmetic.
Do not present incompatible specifications as a ranked winner.
Check extraction coverage by reading all fixture pages. Text-PDF demonstration does not establish scan/OCR support.
If formulas are written with openpyxl, calculate/export values independently or actually run a spreadsheet engine; openpyxl itself does not evaluate formulas.
candidates.initial_prompt: 請比較這三份報價是否符合 requirements.txt。先列原文規格、數量、含稅狀態、運費與原報價總額，每一項附檔名和頁碼。只有規格與數量可對齊的才計算可比較總價；沒寫的填待確認，不猜。原檔不修改，交付可編輯比價表與待問問題清單。
candidates.production_note: Before writing narration, perform one real AI-assisted run from the exact prompt to the actual files and preserve the transcript/tool run. Do not pre-claim that an ordinary prompt fails or that the refined one always succeeds.

arc.beat: Three prices are not yet three comparable offers. One promise: an editable comparison and a list of what still needs asking.
Write the requested quantity/specification before asking AI to compare. Keep the originals and create an output folder.
Give the complete extraction prompt; show the actual source-to-row mapping. Missing terms stay unresolved.
Normalize explicit tax, shipping, units and quantity. Show the workbook's calculation and source fields; do not read out a scoring log.
Mark the nonmatching offer. Explain what would need clarification rather than guessing its upgraded price.
Replace one quote with the revision, rerun, and inspect the changed comparison and questions.
Open the exported table, trace two important values back to source pages, and check the complete delivered totals. One short limitation: this example uses text PDFs, not scanned-image OCR.
Three actions for the viewer's own quotes; answer the opening problem and ask about their usual quote format. No next-video announcement.

minimum_real_execution_before_script: Extract all pages of the original PDFs and confirm the source text is available.
Have the current AI actually produce the normalized table and files from the documented prompt; save that execution.
Independently recompute the eligible totals against fixture truth.
Process the revised PDF and verify changed and preserved fields.
Render and visually inspect at least the important PDF excerpts and the output table.
